folds: the five expanding date folds of stage 7 (selection.common.date_folds, 3-day gap) over the local days of the train rows (smoke: the last 56 days), the loop of the L-09 correction (X68)
model: the xgb record of each fit: searched parameters, seed, constraints by exact name, rounds n_rounds, fixed; no early stopping
held_rows: daytime hours with AC truth, op-limited included, warm-up excluded (X69)
metric: nRMSE in kW, % of 3,449 kW (units.nrmse_kw); the k forecast through to_kw
comparison: validation_uncorrected is the xgb step's value of the same fit on the validation window, which was its early-stopping set (D-10); the CV folds were not
